question: limits[].kind and binding have no term for a read-latency constraint: an archive class charges a restore request and answers hours later (S3 Glacier Deep Archive: up to 12 hours at Standard, up to 48 hours at Bulk), which is what a reader meets before any quota, and it is recorded in limits_note because no kind of the seven describes it. Does the vocabulary need a restore-latency or read-latency kind?
why: the record for storage/aws-s3-glacier-deep-archive puts the 12-48 hour restore time in limits_note and its binding is `none`, because naming a request-rate or a retention-clamped limit as binding would misstate what fails first; every archive class in the corpus (OVHcloud Cold Archive, Scaleway Glacier, Utho Archive) carries the same unclassified value
